verdict.rationale: Cognee exposes a complete memory CRUD surface (`.remember`, `.recall`, `.improve`, `.forget`) as documented API operations, and ships a first-party MCP server so agents can invoke these as tools mid-conversation inside Claude/Cursor/Cline/Codex — runtime probes confirm both the MCP server (stdio JSON-RPC handshake) and CLI (full remember→recall→forget roundtrip) actually work locally without cloud dependency. missing for 10: an independent/hands-on trace of an agent actually calling remember/recall/forget *through* the MCP tool interface (probe only verified the initialize handshake, not full CRUD via MCP) and confirmation that 'update' semantics (not just improve/enrich) are exposed as a callable tool.
